integrity: A complete all-k carry proof accompanies independent finite-depth direct enumeration. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to integer equality of threefold sums of finite ternary digit sets. Lau--Ngai (2000) already determines the continuous 3-fold Cantor convolution q=2 spectral polynomial; the spectral root and exponent are not claimed as original. An earlier equivalent finite-level energy identity may be unindexed.
title: Exact sixth Fourier moments of finite middle-thirds Cantor spectra
